CommunityApplications.Profile: bananana.dev, built by CTF Designs, LLC: your own control room for servers, Macs and PCs. **bananana-brain** runs the brain (dashboard, alerts, automations, history) on your Unraid server; **bananana-node** connects the Unraid server itself to a brain. Both connect out through an end-to-end encrypted relay, so no ports are opened. Help: https://bananana.dev/help · Support: https://bananana.dev/support
